result.reason: The operative redline fully implements the fallback by adding a mutual twelve-month-fees aggregate cap with the four required uncapped carve-outs. It does not satisfy the preferred position because it omits the USD 1,000,000 floor, data protection and security carve-outs, fraud and IP-infringement carve-outs, and the payment-obligations clarification. The change is substantively minimal and does not contradict the existing mutual damages exclusion. Drafting quality is reduced by the undefined timing of "the claim," the potentially ambiguous fee base, and the existing malformed punctuation in "REPRESENTATIVES„ WHETHER."
